question: A certain sum of money amounts to 3 times of itself in 13 years when interest is compounded annually at a certain rate of interest per annum. In how many years will the initial sum amount to 9 times of itself at the same rate of interest per annum, also compounded annually?
solution:
Given:

A certain sum amounts to 3 times in 13 years

Formula used:

Compound interest = Amount - Principal

Amount = P(1+(R)/(100))T

Where P, R and T are principal, rate and time respectively.

Calculation:

Let the sum be P.

Then,

Amount = P(1+(R)/(100))T

⇒ 3P = P(1+(R)/(100))13

⇒ 3 = (1+(R)/(100))13

On squaring both sides, we get:

⇒ (3)² = {(1+(R)/(100))¹³}²

⇒ 9 = (1+(R)/(100))26

Hence, The time required to make the amount 9 times is 26 years.

∴ The Required value of time is 26 years.
